title: CWE Top 25 Most Dangerous Software Weaknesses
description: Maps findings to CWE identifiers, preferring the Top 25 where applicable. Use when the downstream consumer is a vulnerability-management system keyed on CWE.

gate.note: A finding mapping to a Top-25 weakness with a confirmed verification result is treated as release-blocking.
